Afrodeziacz

Afrodeziacz blend Afrobeat, Hip Hop, R&B & Pop into a soulful, high-energy party show with powerhouse vocals, irresistible rhythms & floor-filling grooves.

About Afrodeziacz

Afrodeziacz is a vibrant, genre-blending party band mixing Afrobeats, R&amp;B, Hip Hop , and Pop into an infectious live experience. Fronted by powerhouse duo Sophia and Toraan , and backed by a tight rhythm section of bass , guitar , keys , and drums , this band brings colour, soul, and serious groove to every performance. Their setlist spans Afrobeats favourites like “Love Nwantiti” and “Location” , classic soul by Aretha Franklin and Stevie Wonder , and nostalgic hits by Will Smith , Coolio , and more. For a more intimate touch, their R&amp;B/Soul acoustic medleys are nothing short of magic. Sophia trained at Art Voice Academy and BIMM London , supporting legends like Lionel Richie and Andrea Bocelli . Toraan , a BRIT School alum and West End performer, recently headlined at the O2 Shepherd’s Bush Empire . Their musicians have played with Shaggy , Etana , and on Hollywood soundtracks . With customisable setlists , a free song request , and full PA and lighting , Afrodeziacz brings joy, flair, and professional polish to every event.
